OracleChatVisibility.Name: DMEmu chat visibility
OracleChatVisibility.Hint: Who can see Yes/No, Grand Oracle, generator, and plot beat results posted to chat.

Oracle.About: Yes/No, Grand Oracle, descriptive, story, and quantifier oracles. Use the tabs to switch; enrichment and Grand draws use RollTables.

App.Title: DMEmu Oracle
App.Question: Question (optional)
App.QuestionPlaceholder: e.g. Do the guards notice us?
App.RollBiasTooltip: If you already lean toward an answer, roll twice and pick the result that fits your judgment.
App.BiasHint: Pick the result that best fits your judgment.

PerspectiveHint.deterministic: Objective, universal questions that need a concrete answer.
PerspectiveHint.subjective: Questions from a character’s point of view (may include uncertainty).
PerspectiveHint.conversation: Questions during dialogue with non-protagonist characters.

Oracle.LikelihoodHint: How likely is a yes? This picks a probability table for the d100 — it is not a modifier added to the roll.

strongNo.label: Strong no
strongNo.description: A clear, decisive no—treat it as settled unless something major changes.

no.label: No
no.description: A plain negative. No extra twist unless the scene already suggests one.

weakNo.label: Weak no
weakNo.description: Leans no, but soft—hesitation, a narrow miss, or room to push again.

weakYes.label: Weak yes
weakYes.description: Leans yes, but soft—partial success, conditions, or it barely holds.

yes.label: Yes
yes.description: A plain affirmative. Play it straight unless other cues add color.

strongYes.label: Strong yes
strongYes.description: A clear, decisive yes—lean into it with confidence or momentum.

noDefinitelyNot.label: No, definitely not
noDefinitelyNot.description: From their view: firmly rejected. They are sure of the no.

noApparentlyNot.label: No, apparently not
noApparentlyNot.description: Seems like no based on what they know or sense—could be incomplete info.

noNotYet.label: No, not yet
noNotYet.description: Not now; timing or readiness is wrong. A later yes remains possible.

noBut.label: No, but...
noBut.description: No to the ask, yet something useful, related, or compensatory comes with it.

dontKnow.label: Don’t know, can’t tell
dontKnow.description: They lack certainty—ignorance, confusion, or senses that will not settle it.

itDepends.label: It depends (on skill)
itDepends.description: Outcome hinges on ability, roll, or approach—resolve with a check or similar.

yesBut.label: Yes, but...
yesBut.description: Yes with a catch: cost, risk, complication, or limited scope.

yesSometimes.label: Yes, sometimes
yesSometimes.description: True only in some cases or moods—not a reliable always.

yesApparently.label: Yes, apparently
yesApparently.description: Looks like yes from their vantage; they may be wrong or missing a detail.

yesAbsolutely.label: Yes, absolutely
yesAbsolutely.description: From their view: full confidence in yes—play their certainty.

noAnd.label: No, and...
noAnd.description: Refusal plus fallout—anger, a new problem, or they make things worse.

noDefinitelyNot.label: No, definitely not
noDefinitelyNot.description: Hard refusal in dialogue; little room to negotiate right now.

noDangerous.label: No, it’s dangerous
noDangerous.description: No because of risk or threat—they warn, fear, or refuse for safety.

noTooLate.label: No, it’s too late
noTooLate.description: The window closed; the answer would have been different earlier.

noIThinkNot.label: No, I think not
noIThinkNot.description: Soft spoken no—uncertain or polite refusal, not a slammed door.

noUnless.label: No, unless...
noUnless.description: No by default, but a condition, favor, or change could flip it.

noBut.label: No, but...
noBut.description: They decline the ask yet offer an alternative, tip, or partial help.

iDontKnow.label: I don’t know
iDontKnow.description: They claim ignorance—or will not say. Pressing may change that.

itsComplicated.label: It’s complicated
itsComplicated.description: Not a clean yes/no; politics, secrets, or tangled motives are in play.

yesBut.label: Yes, but...
yesBut.description: Agreement with strings attached—price, favor, or warning.

yesForAPrice.label: Yes, for a price
yesForAPrice.description: They will help if paid, owed, or given something they want.

yesPrettySure.label: Yes, pretty sure
yesPrettySure.description: Mostly confident yes in speech; small doubt remains.

yesHurryUp.label: Yes, hurry up
yesHurryUp.description: Yes under time pressure—act now or the chance slips.

yesBeCareful.label: Yes, be careful
yesBeCareful.description: Yes with a caution; danger or subtlety comes with the agreement.

yesOfCourse.label: Yes, of course
yesOfCourse.description: Easy, natural yes—as if the ask was expected or obvious.

yesAnd.label: Yes, and...
yesAnd.description: Yes plus more—extra help, info, or a twist that advances things.

Grand.Hint: Roll Action, Adjective, and Subject, then weave them into one cue for the scene.
Grand.RollAllTooltip: Roll all three tables once and post a single combined prompt to chat.
Grand.ActionHint: What is happening — verbs and deeds. Roll alone or as part of Grand Oracle.
Grand.AdjectiveHint: Tone or quality of the situation. Roll alone or as part of Grand Oracle.
Grand.Subject: Subject (what)
Grand.SubjectHint: Noun or focus of the prompt. Roll alone or as part of Grand Oracle.
Grand.ChatHint: Interpret the combo freely; pick any synonym from each line that fits.

Group.DescriptiveHint: Scene details you can perceive. Optionally enrich with Description (looks).
Group.StoryHint: Plot motives, discoveries, and risks. Optionally enrich with Focus (what).
Group.QuantifierHint: Set a baseline first, then roll for how much / how good / how hard relative to that.

Enrichment.NoticeHint: Something draws attention—a sensory hook to fit to the scene.
Enrichment.SomeoneHint: Identify a character by a defining feature.
Enrichment.PlaceHint: Generate a location from a key detail.
Enrichment.ObjectHint: An item based on function, purpose, or value.
Enrichment.HazardHint: The nature of a danger when facing a threat.
Enrichment.MoodHint: Atmosphere or emotional tone of a scene or NPC.
Enrichment.DescriptionHint: Visual or sensory detail to enrich another answer.
Enrichment.FocusHint: A noun or theme (thing, goal, discovery) to hang meaning on.
Enrichment.ReasonHint: Why an event or action took place.
Enrichment.IntentHint: What somebody wants from your characters.
Enrichment.ActivityHint: What an actor is currently engaged in.
Enrichment.DiscoveryHint: What the characters learn when they deserve an explanation.
Enrichment.ProblemHint: A stake, consequence, or thing at risk.
Enrichment.HowGoodHint: Relative quality or success vs your baseline.
Enrichment.PackMissing: DMEmu rollTables pack is not available.
Enrichment.TableMissing: That enrichment table was not found in the pack.

Generators.About: Build seeds, places, factions, adversaries, and characters from prompt tables. Combined rolls post one chat card; single buttons draw one table.
Generators.ChatHint: Interpret freely; adapt each line to your setting or re-roll what does not fit.
Generators.PackMissing: DMEmu rollTables pack is not available.
Generators.TableMissing: That generator table was not found in the pack.

Group.SeedHint: World truths and plot pieces. Combine into a starting situation, or draw one cue at a time.
Group.WorldHint: Factions, places, objects, nemeses, and creatures. Combined rolls stack several facets into one prompt.
Group.CharactersHint: Traits, scene presence, archetypes, and purposes. Combined rolls assemble a fuller portrait.

Combo.PlotSeedHint: Hook, motivation, mission, lead, caveat, and opposition in one chat card.
Combo.FactionHint: Focus, needs, society, politics, and beliefs.

Table.LocationArchetypeHint: Setting and environment for the game world.
Table.PlotHookHint: What kicks the story into motion.
Table.MotivationHint: Why the protagonists take it on.
Table.MissionHint: What they are trying to accomplish.
Table.InitialLeadHint: A concrete first scene or clue.
Table.OppositionHint: Who or what stands against them.
Table.FactionNeedsHint: A surplus or shortage—decide which fits.
Table.LocationFeatureHint: A defining characteristic of a place.
Table.ObjectFunctionHint: What the object is meant to do.
Table.CharIntentionsHint: What they want from you now.
Table.CharActivityHint: What they are doing when met.

Plot.About: Track one story problem at a time: fill plot nodes, draw beats, and advance the track when a beat matters.
Plot.JournalPageHint: Freeform notes for this plot. The Summary page is rewritten automatically when you save from the Plot Sheet window.
Plot.CreateFailed: Could not create plot sheet journal.
Plot.MissingSheet: Plot sheet journal was not found.
Plot.PackMissing: DMEmu rollTables pack is not available.
Plot.TableMissing: That plot beat table was not found in the pack.
Plot.StashEmpty: No recent prompt to paste. Draw a generator, oracle, or beat first.

App.Title: DMEmu Plot Sheet
App.Name: Name
App.ScopePlaceholder: e.g. Stop the raiders before they reach the river town
App.ScopeHint: The problem or goal this sheet is about.
App.BeatsHint: Draw when you need a twist or do not know what happens next. Confirm advance only after a beat proves relevant.
App.RandomPromptTooltip: No clear idea — roll a complication, catalyst, challenge, or situation.
App.ModifiedProposalTooltip: You have an idea — twist it, or divert into a node or ABCD table.
App.ConfirmAdvanceTooltip: Mark the next track box after a beat that mattered to the plot.
App.PasteStashTooltip: Paste the last oracle/generator/beat prompt into this slot
App.NoSheetHint: Open an existing sheet or create a new one to edit scope and type.
App.NoTrackHint: This sheet type has no plot track — use beats freely and keep progress in your Notes page if you like.

Beat.ChatHint: Play the result for a while. Advance the track only if it mattered.
Beat.NodeEmpty: No filled {category} nodes yet — write one in, or treat this as a cue to add something new.

Summary.AutoHint: This page is generated from the Plot Sheet app. Edit track and nodes there; freeform writing belongs on the Notes page.
